Copied from ESP project

## Import visits

```{r import_visits}
# Time:  mins (ErisOne)
# Time: 1.5 mins (awing)
system.time({
  df = fread(paste0(dir_rpdrml, "RPDRml__visit.txt"),
             # This could be all rows or a sample of rows.
             nrows = sample_rows) 
})

# 570 MM rows
dim(df)

class(df)

names(df)
```

## Integrate with diagnoses

We need the diagnosis file to have the subject_num for a visit

```{r integrate_diagnoses}
diagnoses = fst::read.fst(here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/diagnoses.fst")),
                          as.data.table = TRUE)

str(diagnoses)
str(df)

system.time({
  df2 = merge(df,
              # All we need is encounter number and subject_num out of the diagnosis file.
              unique(diagnoses[, .(encounter_num, subject_num)],
                     by = c("encounter_num", "subject_num")),
              by = "encounter_num",
              all.x = TRUE)
})

# These should be equal.
c(nrow(df), nrow(df2))
head(df2)

# Why do 31.8 MM visits have no subject_num? I guess because they aren't part
# of the study sample.
sum(is.na(df2$subject_num))

df3 = df2[!is.na(subject_num)]
dim(df3)
names(df3)
```

```{r}
rm(diagnoses)
gc()
```


## Load unshift file

```{r load_unshift_file}
# Hyunjoon received from Victor and shared with Chris via MGB Dropbox.
unshift_df = fread(here("data-raw/RPDRml_v2024_1_empi_map.csv"))

str(unshift_df)

# 3 - 12 days
table(unshift_df$random_offset)

intersect(names(df3), names(unshift_df))

names(unshift_df)

# Left join relative to df.
# Time: 1.4 seconds (awing)
system.time({
  df4 = merge(df3,
              unshift_df[, .(subject_num, empi, random_offset)],
              by = "subject_num", all.x = TRUE)
})

# 0 missing empi
mean(is.na(df4$empi))
# 419 records are missing empi - not too shabby.
sum(is.na(df4$empi))

df = df4

# 8.9 MM rows.
dim(df)

# Clean up
rm(unshift_df)
rm(df2, df3, df4)
gc()
```

## Clean dates




```{r clean_dates}

# No missing values
sum(is.na(df$random_offset))

# Incorporate the random offset from RPDR-ML
# If it is missing, we'll get a missing value for sstart_date.
# CK: changed these to + on 2022-10-22. Need to double-check that this is right.
df[, start_date := lubridate::mdy(sstart_date) + random_offset]
# TODO: confirm with Victor that end date needs to be modified.
df[, end_date := lubridate::mdy(send_date) + random_offset]

# Range: Aug 5, 1996 to April 8, 2023
summary(df$start_date)
# Nov. 5, 1994 to April 8, 2023; 725k NAs.
summary(df$end_date)

names(df)
```

## Remove extra cols

```{r remove_extra_cols}
head(df)
remove_cols = c("clinic_cd", "clinic_name", "sstart_date", "send_date") # new start and end dates are stored with different column names


# This line will show a warning in RStudio but we are intentionally leaving the row argument empty.
data.table::set(df, , remove_cols, NULL)

```

## Save dataset

```{r save_dataset}
str(df)
system.time({
  fst::write.fst(df,
                 here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/visits.fst")))
})

# Clean up RAM
rm(df)
gc()
```

# DX-Visits dataset

```{r dx_visits}
system.time({
  df = fst::read.fst(here::here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/diagnoses.fst")),
                     as.data.table = TRUE)
  
  visits = fst::read.fst(here::here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/visits.fst")),
                   as.data.table = TRUE)
})
```




```{r}
# Review column names
names(df)
names(visits)
```


```{r merging_dx_visits}
# Join visits and diagnoses; left join relative to visits
# Time: 4 mins (awing)
system.time({
  dx_visits = merge(visits, df %>% select(-c(empi, subject_num)), by = "encounter_num", all.x = TRUE)
})

dim(dx_visits)
names(dx_visits)

rm(df, visits)
gc()

```

# Save dx visits

```{r save_dx_visits}
# save file as fst
system.time({
  fst::write.fst(dx_visits,
                 here::here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/diagnoses-visits.fst")))
})

```



```{r}
# clean up

rm(dx_visits)
gc()
```
